title: contracts/harness/ledger.jsonl, one line -- one outcome of one proposal, with the commit that shows it
description: What happened to a proposal, one outcome per line, append-only (plan.md 8.3). A proposal's stage is derived from its last ledger line, never written into the proposal, so no proposal can say it landed when it did not. Landed and reverted name the commit that did it. A landed line also carries the one command that reverts it, because the day's report to the person lists every tightening that landed with that command (the person's settlement of 2026-10-16, item c). A revert is an outcome like any other. This is a line schema; the file is JSONL and is judged line by line.

outcome.description: drafted: the proposal file exists. handed: given to the owner seat named in `to`, to build and land. landed: committed by its owner. refused: the owner or the gate declined it, with why in note. reverted: undone after landing. withdrawn: the meta-harness took it back. undecided: it needs a threshold or a word nobody has given.

by_seat.description: The seat that wrote this line.

to.description: For handed: the seat it was handed to.

revert_command.description: For landed: the one command that undoes it, e.g. git revert <commit>.

said_in_window_of.description: the seat whose window the person said it in, or console:<login> when it was given through the console under that login (HP-016, 659c2214). The console form counts only for a loosening or a retirement that touches no part of the core, and only with recorded_in naming the permission file the person committed

recorded_in.description: where the word is recorded. Optional for a word said in a window, whose record is the proposal's; required for the console form, where it is the permission file's path
